summary: The code is syntactically valid and imports are resolved, but the simulation is not implemented end-to-end. main() is a no-op, the Simulation class initialization is incomplete, no network is loaded or used, no run loop or calibration/metrics are executed, and required agent attributes/behaviors per the task are missing. Therefore, it does not produce predictions for days 30–39 nor evaluate RMSE.

issues.description: main() is empty and no simulation is executed or orchestrated, so the program produces no outputs or predictions.
issues.solution: Implement main() to construct the Simulation, run the day-by-day loop (including policy, info diffusion, network stats, adoption decision, market updates, and aggregation), and save or print outputs for days 30–39.

issues.description: Simulation._initialize_entities_and_data ends mid-loop and does not finish creating agents, initial mask/info states, network layers, or modules.
issues.solution: Complete the loop to instantiate PersonAgent objects, populate self.agents, initialize self.state['agent_mask'] and self.state['agent_info'] for all agents, build/load the multiplex network via NetworkBuilder, instantiate PolicyEnvironment, SupplyMarket, InformationSource, and module classes, and prepare for the run loop.

issues.description: The code does not run any simulation loop (days 0..time_horizon), does not compute daily adoption, does not predict days 30–39, and does not compute RMSE or other metrics.
issues.location: Simulation class (no run method) and main()
issues.solution: Add a run() method to Simulation to iterate over days, invoke PolicyEnvironmentModule, InformationDiffusionModule, NetworkStatsModule, SupplyMarket, AdoptionDecisionModule, AdoptionAggregatorModule, collect daily outputs, and at the end compute evaluation metrics against train_data.csv. Call this from main().

issues.description: The social network specified in social_network.json is never loaded or used. NetworkBuilder exists but is not invoked.
issues.solution: Load the multiplex network using NetworkBuilder.load_or_build_network with agent IDs and the social_network.json path, store layers in self.layers, and pass them to the modules that require them.

issues.description: Agent attributes do not match the required specification. Several required attributes are missing (e.g., health_risk_level, network_neighbors, propensity_to_adopt, sensitivities, compliance_probability, fatigue_decay_rate).
issues.solution: Extend PersonAgent to include the specified attributes and initialize them from agent_attributes.csv (with appropriate imputation) or reasonable defaults.

issues.description: Calibration to the first 30 days (e.g., grid search for parameters, RMSE target) and validation criteria are not implemented.
issues.solution: Implement a simple calibration routine (e.g., grid search over a subset of parameters like beta weights or weights in the model plan) to minimize RMSE_of_adoption over days 0–29, respect prior bounds, and include convergence and goodness-of-fit checks per the validation criteria.

issues.description: Aggregation of adoption rates will be incorrect because mask_state is not fully initialized for all agents; only agents present as keys will be counted.
issues.solution: Initialize mask_state for every agent ID with 0 or 1. Ensure the aggregator divides by the full population size (len(self.agents)) not len(mask_state) if mask_state may be sparse.

issues.description: The data files path for social network is not used, and potential fallback to synthetic network is not integrated.
issues.location: Simulation initialization (paths defined but not used)
issues.solution: Invoke NetworkBuilder with self.network_file; if file read fails, use its synthetic generation to build family/work/community layers.

issues.description: networkx is imported and used only in NetworkBuilder, which is not currently used by the simulation.
issues.solution: Either integrate NetworkBuilder into the simulation (preferred) or remove the dependency if not needed.

issues.description: Potential performance overhead generating Watts-Strogatz graphs for large populations, and per-day per-edge loops in information diffusion.
issues.solution: Optimize by using vectorized operations or adjacency arrays, or provide configuration to downscale network size during calibration if datasets are large.

issues.description: Limited error handling around social network loading (silent fallback in NetworkBuilder) and missing robust handling in the main simulation loop (which is absent).
issues.solution: Log specific exceptions when network loading fails and clearly indicate fallback to synthetic. Add try/except around the daily run loop and I/O to ensure graceful degradation.
